propositions: Plan-review end-to-end wall time is approximately 15–22 minutes at current regime (p50=12.6m padded to p90 padded 15.1–21.2m), driven partly by post-workflow overlap and duplicate-judgment work and partly by deterministic setup.

Completion-verifier pre-workflow overhead dominates latency (p50/p90/p99 omitted pre-workflow time 354/1619/3383s), caused by commit_impact.referencing_commits and _scan_alias walking 3.8M ticket directories on impact-present closes.

Inner-workflow sidecar metrics.total_ms understates operator-visible rebar review-plan and gated-close duration by 100–2000s due to setup, signing, persistence, and post-model work not captured in workflow timer.
Current-regime gated-close latency is approximately 35–70 minutes (p50=28.2m padded to p90 padded 33.9–68.8m) with tail sensitivity and small sample; pre-workflow scanning is the dominant cost.

Percentile computation used Hyndman-Fan type 7 linear interpolation; full matched cohort is 78 end-to-end plan and 38 end-to-end close observations post-2026-08-07 provider fix; current regime (≥2026-08-22) is 20 plan and 10 close.
